title: im new to this mall world thing.
content: i remember dreaming of a large mall area that had that typical 80s neon lighting vibe. i believe i was an actor. i was making a film with two women of asian descent. it was abstract, but i ended up ruining the film. this area felt real. there was tons of people walking around the mall, and i could see most of their faces. this isn't typical of my usual dreams, usually i only see the faces of those i know irl. these were people ive never seen before.
